diagnosis: The WebAssembly media processing endpoint reads binary asset files from disk by assetId without checking if the asset belongs to req.user.tenantId. An attacker can invoke pre-compiled WASM transforms on private media files and proprietary datasets belonging to other tenants, exfiltrating the processed output.
exploit_request:

Host: wasm-edge.mediacloud.net

{
  "wasmModuleId": "invert_filter",
